Heroes of the Storm

Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - September 28, 2026

Blizzard Entertainment

Our next Heroes of the Storm patch is live! Read on for more information.

NOTE: Orange text indicates a change between PTR and Live notes.

Hotfix - 10/5/2026

  • Xal'atath Balance Updates

    Abilities
  • Shadow Mark (Q)
    • Void Orb speed slightly increased.
  • Void Step (E)
    • Targeting range reduced from 5 to 2.
    • Distance between teleport points reduced from 7 to 6.5.
    • Now prevented and interrupted by Immobilize.
  • Void Volley (D)
    • Base damage per missile reduced from 90 to 72.
    • Now generates 1 charge for every Basic Attack against enemy Heroes and every 2 Basic Attacks against non-Heroes.
  • Void Eruption (R)
    • Uncharged damage reduced by 20%.
    • Fully charged damage reduced by 5%.

  • Talents
  • Level 1
    • Anchored Core
      • Radius bonus reduced from 50% to 25%.
  • Level 4
    • Dark Barrier
      • Now only triggers when enemy Heroes are hit
  • Level 7
    • Silence of the Lamb
      • Silence duration increased from 1 to 1.5 seconds.
  • Level 13
    • Dark Heart's Protection
      • Detonating the Dark Heart on a target affected by Shadow Mark now Silences all enemies hit. Previously silenced on cast.
  • Level 20
    • Rift Invasion
      • Portals now have non-lethal Health decay, stopping at 4 Health.

  • Xal'atath Bug Fixes
  • General
    • Orbiting orbs now pause during Time Stop and resume afterward.
    • Fixed issues that prevented orbiting orbs from correctly following the missile or continuing to orbit after a release queued during Time Stop.
    • Fixed an issue where Xal'atath was appearing brighter than intended in the game.
  • Void Volley (D)
    • Fixed an issue that caused impact visual effects to appear at the cursor location instead of where missiles hit.
    • Fixed an issue that prevented the charge indicator from immediately displaying 1 charge upon reaching the second milestone.
  • Void Eruption (R)
    • Can now be queued to cast or release during Time Stop.
    • Casting during Time Stop immediately enters targeting, with charging beginning when Time Stop ends.
    • Releasing during Time Stop queues the release for when Time Stop ends. The Ability button becomes greyed out while a release is queued.
    • Issuing another Ability, movement, or attack order during Time Stop cancels the pending cast or queued release.
    • Casting Void Eruption again during Time Stop clears earlier queued orders.
    • Fixed issues that could allow an additional charge to begin while already charging or during Void Step.
    • Orb growth and the flight damage timer now pause while Xal’atath is affected by Time Stop.
  • General Bug Fixes
    • ​Fixed an issue where certain Maskless skins were not appearing in the game.

Hotfix - 9/29/2026

  • Fixed an issue where some players who bought the pre-purchase bundle didn't receive Xal'atath.
  • Fixed an exploit with Xal'atath's ultimate.
  • Fixed an issue where Level 20 Void Convergence portal would lose life.
  • Adjusted colors on Dark Heart to make visibility clearer for enemies.

New Hero: Xal'atath

Xal'atath has arrived in the Nexus!

Base

  • Shadow Mark [Q]
    • Shoot a single Void Orb that deals 75 damage to enemies hit, and an additional 150 damage to enemies in the center.
    • If an enemy Hero or Structure is hit by the center, they are marked for 4 seconds.
    • Targets afflicted by Shadow Mark are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions towards them.
  • Dark Heart Ritual [W]
    • Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 50 damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.
    • The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.
    • The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonates on impact, dealing 305 damage to nearby enemies and an additional 150 more damage to the Marked target.
  • Void Step [E]
    • Cast to teleport Xal'atath 3 times in a triangular pattern.
    • Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage while the Ability is active.
    • Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at the current location.
    • Weapon Bonus Damage caps at +30%.
  • Void Volley [Trait]
    • After attacking enemies with her Basic Attacks 5 times, Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 90 damage on impact.
    • Charge fully decays if Xal'atath does not hit an enemy with a Basic Attack after 6 seconds.
    • Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit increases Void Volley damage by 1%. Lose all stacks upon dying.
      • Reward (20 Stacks): Increase Void Volley's range by 2. Upon death, Xal'atath now only loses 6 stacks, but cannot fall below her current milestone minimum
      • Reward (60 Stacks): Void Volley requires 1 fewer Basic Attack to charge Void Volley.
      • Mythic Reward (100 Stacks): Increase Basic Attack and Void Volley damage by 50%. Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.
    • Stack loss will never cause the Hero to fall below a quest reward threshold.

Talents

  • Level 1
    • Void Adept
      • Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.
      • Each successful detonation permanently increases Shadow Mark and the Dark Heart Ritual Detonation damage by 25, up to 20 times
    • Anchored Core
      • Increase Dark Heart's area by 50% and duration by 25%.
      • Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 damage.
    • Cloak of Shadows
      • Activating Void Step grants 50% Movement Speed and 25 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.
  • Level 4
    • Cold Feet
      • Increase Shadow Mark's duration by 1 second.
      • Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark have their Movement Speed reduced by 25%.
    • Dark Barrier
      • Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.
    • Void Acolyte
      • Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.
      • The next Void Volley deals 50% increased damage and costs no Mana.
  • Level 7
    • Toxic Mark
      • Increase Shadow Mark's duration by 1 second.
      • Heroes afflicted with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by 15 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.
    • Silence of the Lamb
      • Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 250 damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.
    • Void Summoner
      • Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xalatath's original position. Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.
      • Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.
      • Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 95 damage per hit. Void Minions lose Health over 15 seconds.
  • Level 10
    • Void Eruption [R]
      • Channel a single powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.
      • Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take up to 112 damage and are Blinded for 1 second.
      • When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 damage.
      • Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 and its explosion damage up to 700.
      • Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.
    • Void Convergence [R]
      • After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.
      • You can have up to 1 active Void Portal.
      • Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.
      • Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push.
      • Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.
      • The Portal expires after 12 seconds.
      • Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 56 damage per hit.
      • Void Minion loses Health over 12 seconds.
  • Level 13
    • Pull of the Dark Heart
      • Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.
    • Dark Heart's Protection
      • Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.
      • Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside Dark Heart's radius.
    • Crushing Cascade
      • Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by 6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.
  • Level 16
    • Marked Resilience
      • Basic Attacks against enemy targets afflicted by Shadow Mark grant a 180 point Shield that rapidly decays.
    • Relentless Whispers
      • While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by 150%.
    • Fractured Reality
      • Increase Void Volley projectile damage by 25%.
      • Void Volley projectiles leave a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 damage to enemies.
      • Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flame.
      • Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds.
      • Damage increases up to 300%.
      • Damage increase from multiple fires stack.
  • Level 20
    • Harbinger's Consumption
      • Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.
    • Rift Invasion
      • Void Convergence's Void Portal no longer has a life duration, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.
    • Dueling Orbs
      • Gain 1 additional Shadow Mark charge.
      • Shadow Mark has a 3 second cooldown between uses.
    • Unstable Core
      • When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on an enemy Hero afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 5 seconds.
      • Enemies in the flames take 45 damage over time.
      • The flames deal damage every 1 second.
    • Paradox Loop
      • After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.
